about.title: About
about.hint: Over a decade of experience implementing fully custom, high—quality interactive experiences for brands and companies worldwide.
about.detail:
Born and raised in Mallorca, I always had a strong interest in design and tech. I studied computer engineering, but soon found myself leaning towards more creative ways of implementing software. Captivated by animation and interactions, and driven to gain expertise in these areas, I eventually moved to Barcelona, where I worked at some of the most creative agencies for brands and companies including Google, Nike, and Netflix.

In 2020, I moved to Cádiz, and began my solo journey as a freelancer. However, over the past few years, I rented a workspace and frequently collaborated with other professionals to meet my clients’ needs. This is why it now feels more like a small studio. From fellow developers to designers, copywriters, and SEO and marketing experts, I’ve built a network that ensures our final results meet the high standards I aim to deliver.

That said, my priority is to put personal interaction first, making it easy and enjoyable to work together. As you scroll down, you’ll find some of our clients, their experience collaborating with us, a photo gallery to get to know the studio a little better, and a showcase of some the recognitions we’ve received over the years.
